units.source_text: “明儿要做法事，拿这个去买束花上供吧。”

en.t: Tomorrow there will be a memorial service, so use this to buy a bouquet of flowers as an offering.

units.source_text: 我说着，将一小包为数不多的钱让荣吉带回去。

en.t: As I said this, I had Eikichi take back a small packet of the little money I had.

units.source_text: 我自己则不得不乘明早的船回东京，

en.t: As for me, I had no choice but to take the boat back to Tokyo the next morning,

units.source_text: 因为我的旅费已全花光。

en.t: because I had already spent all my travel money.

units.source_text: 我对艺人们说学校里有事，

en.t: I told the performers that I had business at school,
so they could no longer insist on keeping me there.
